headline: Getty Images Files for Bankruptcy and Plans to Go Private
summary: Getty Images has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in Delaware under a plan to hand the company to the Getty family and Koch Equity Development while cutting its debt.
why: Getty Images is a prominent visual media company and provider of digital imagery. Bankruptcy and restructuring proceedings directly impact its equity holders, creditors, and overall corporate valuation.

impacts.name: Getty Images
impacts.why: Chapter 11 restructuring and ownership transfer to the Getty family and Koch Equity Development create uncertainty for existing stakeholders and debt holders.
